`DbClientAttributesGetter.getErrorType()` now supplies the final `error.type` for database and SQL extraction. Returning `null` omits the attribute, even with an exception; the default still returns the exception class name.

Overrides that relied on extractor fallback can return the exception class directly:

```java
return customType != null
    ? customType
    : error == null ? null : error.getClass().getName();
```

Built-in getters retain protocol-code precedence, exception unwrapping, cancellation, and span-status behavior. This is the database portion of the breaking 3.0 contract change tracked in #20679; other getter families remain separate.
metadata.title: Make database getters own final error classification
